title: Flux: GitOps from Inside the Cluster
intro: CI/CD covered GitOps with Argo CD. Flux is the other widely used tool, and works the same way underneath: controllers in the cluster pull from Git and apply what they find, on a loop. It has no central UI; you drive it with the flux CLI and ordinary Kubernetes objects. The cluster syncs from the repository fleet-infra.

steps.prompt: Check where Flux pulls from, and whether the latest commit has been fetched: list its Git sources in all namespaces.
steps.fake_output:
NAMESPACE     NAME          REVISION             SUSPENDED   READY   MESSAGE
flux-system   fleet-infra   main@sha1:a1f9c3e2   False       True    stored artifact for revision 'main@sha1:a1f9c3e2'
steps.explanation: One source, on main at commit a1f9c3e2, fetched successfully.
steps.why: Flux splits the work in two. A source controller fetches Git (or Helm, or OCI) and stores an artifact; other controllers apply it. So the first question when a change hasn't arrived is whether the source has the commit. If READY is False here, it's credentials or network, and nothing downstream can be current.

steps.prompt: List what Flux applies from that source: the Kustomizations in all namespaces.
steps.fake_output:
NAMESPACE     NAME             REVISION             SUSPENDED   READY   MESSAGE
flux-system   infrastructure   main@sha1:a1f9c3e2   False       True    Applied revision: main@sha1:a1f9c3e2
flux-system   apps             main@sha1:7c2b0d14   False       False   Deployment/shop/api dry-run failed: spec.template.spec.containers[0].resources.limits.memory: Invalid value: "1GB"
steps.explanation: infrastructure is current. apps is stuck on an older commit because a manifest is invalid.
steps.why: A Flux Kustomization is 'apply this path from that source, every N minutes'. When a manifest fails validation, Flux applies nothing from that Kustomization and stays on the last good revision, which is safer than applying half. The message names the object and field: '1GB' isn't a Kubernetes quantity ('1Gi' is). The fix belongs in Git.

steps.prompt: The fix has been pushed. Don't wait for the next interval: fetch the source and reconcile the Kustomization apps now.
steps.fake_output:
► annotating GitRepository fleet-infra in flux-system namespace
✔ fetched revision main@sha1:e4d7a920
► annotating Kustomization apps in flux-system namespace
✔ applied revision main@sha1:e4d7a920
steps.explanation: Flux fetched the new commit and applied it.
steps.why: --with-source refreshes Git first; without it Flux re-applies the commit it already has, which is the usual reason 'reconcile did nothing'. Reconciling is always safe: it only ever applies what Git says.

steps.prompt: During an incident you need to change a Deployment by hand, and Flux would revert it within minutes. Pause reconciliation of the Kustomization apps.
steps.fake_output:
► suspending kustomization apps in flux-system namespace
✔ kustomization suspended
steps.explanation: Flux leaves everything under apps alone until it's resumed.
steps.why: Reverting manual changes is the feature: the cluster can't drift from Git. In an emergency that same feature undoes your fix, so suspend first, deliberately. Then the obligation is yours: put the change into Git and resume ('flux resume kustomization apps'), or the cluster stays frozen and silently out of date. Alert on anything suspended for longer than a few hours.

steps.prompt: Find recent errors across all of Flux's controllers.
steps.fake_output:
2026-09-28T11:02:14Z error Kustomization/apps.flux-system - Reconciliation failed after 1.2s, next try in 10m0s: Deployment/shop/api dry-run failed
2026-09-28T09:40:01Z error HelmRelease/redis.cache - Helm upgrade failed: timed out waiting for the condition
steps.explanation: The earlier manifest error, and a Helm release that timed out this morning.
steps.why: With no UI, the logs and 'flux get all -A' are the dashboard, and nobody watches them. Configure Flux's notification controller to send failures to chat or to post commit statuses, so that a sync failing on Friday isn't discovered when Monday's deploy mysteriously doesn't arrive.
